visionFocus.eyeRestBody: If you have been on a screen for a while, rest your eyes for 1–2 minutes before beginning. Look at something far away or close your eyes briefly — tired eyes can make results less reliable.

far.title: Distance Vision Tests
far.subtitle: Recommended for blurry board, TV, road signs, or far objects.
far.routing: Distance focused tests selected based on your blur report.

near.title: Near Vision Tests
near.subtitle: Recommended for blurry phone, book, laptop, or near reading.
near.routing: Near focused tests selected based on your blur report.

both.title: Complete Vision Assessment
both.subtitle: Recommended when both distance and near vision feel unclear.
both.routing: Complete assessment selected because both near and far feel blurry.

unsure.title: Quick Vision Screener
unsure.subtitle: We'll start with a short screener to recommend the right tests.
unsure.routing: We'll start with a short screener to recommend the right tests.

near.title: Full Near Vision Battery
near.description: Near acuity, astigmatism (CYL & axis), near–far switching, duochrome, and simulator for the most accurate near eyesight number.

far.title: Full Distance Refraction Battery
far.description: Distance acuity, astigmatism (CYL & axis), duochrome, and simulator for the most accurate distance eyesight number.

both.title: Full Refraction Battery
both.description: Distance and near modules for complete refractive screening.

snellen-acuity.title: Distance Eyesight Number Test
snellen-acuity.description: Letter acuity plus astigmatism fan for SPH, CYL, and axis. At the squint line, enter that row entirely incorrectly (no guessing). For higher accuracy, use the Full Distance Refraction Battery.

jaeger-acuity.title: Near Eyesight Number Test
jaeger-acuity.description: Near reading chart at 40–50 cm plus astigmatism fan for SPH, CYL, and axis. For the most accurate near number, use the Full Near Vision Battery.

refraction-simulator.title: Refraction Simulator
refraction-simulator.description: Interactive clearer comparisons — primary estimated sphere.

duochrome-refinement.title: Duochrome Test
duochrome-refinement.description: Red-green balance to refine sphere by about ±0.25 D.

refraction-battery.title: Full Refraction Battery
refraction-battery.description: Acuity, astigmatism, duochrome, and refraction simulator combined for a complete estimated prescription.

near-far-switching.title: Near Far Switching
near-far-switching.description: Checks how quickly your eyes adjust between near and far focus.

quick-screener.title: Quick Vision Screener
quick-screener.description: One distance and one near check to recommend distance, near, or complete tests.

blur-screener.title: Blur Screener
blur-screener.description: Short distance and near clarity checks to route you to the right follow-up tests.

color-vision.title: Colour Vision Test
color-vision.description: 14-plate Ishihara-style procedural test — screens for red-green colour deficiency across 4 difficulty levels.

landolt-acuity.title: Landolt C Acuity
landolt-acuity.description: Adaptive tumbling-ring staircase — pinpoints sharpest readable size for a precise acuity estimate.

contrast-sensitivity.title: Contrast Sensitivity
contrast-sensitivity.description: Distance faint-letter screening — at the squint line, enter that row entirely incorrectly (no guessing). Does not estimate diopters directly.

orientation-discrimination.title: Orientation Discrimination
orientation-discrimination.description: Line orientation sensitivity — available from advanced menu only.

rapid-recognition.title: Rapid Recognition
rapid-recognition.description: Recognition speed — not used for eyesight number estimation.

sustained-focus.title: Sustained Focus
sustained-focus.description: Coming soon — not part of core refractive screening.

blurScreener.introUnsureBody: We'll quickly check both distance and near clarity. This only helps choose your next test — it is not a prescription or diagnosis.
blurScreener.introBothBody: You reported blur both near and far. We'll run a short distance check and a near check to see which area needs follow-up testing.
blurScreener.distancePartHint: Part 1: Sit about 60–80 cm from your screen.
blurScreener.nearPartHint: Part 2: Move closer to about 35–40 cm for near reading.

blurScreener.distanceHint: Sit 60–80 cm from the screen. Each letter appears alone.
